name: volumio_autodj
description: Continuous play: automatically extends Volumio's play queue with similar tracks once it's about to run out: from your local library first, from TIDAL, Qobuz, HIGHRESAUDIO or Spotify if set up.
author: Celindir69

volumio_info.details: Watches the play queue and, once it's about to run out, appends a track by an artist similar to what's currently playing (via Deezer, or the Last.fm API with a key), matched against your local library first and, for artists not found there, against the streaming services set up in Volumio.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.4.0: never picks tracks tagged NoMix or "don't like" in the Xplorio tag service. 1.3.0: Last.fm key optional, similar artists from Deezer without it (Last.fm keys need Last.fm Pro from December 2026). 1.2.0: boundary watcher as a systemd service, only errors in Volumio's log, cleanup after a failed installation.
